about: Every fixture of this folder. A file under good/ must validate against 'schema'. A file under bad/ must be refused, and 'rule' says which rule it breaks; 'expect' names the schema keyword that refuses it and the place in the fixture where it does (a JSON Pointer, '' for the whole value). The keys and digests are made up for the fixtures. Files named h* and b* were written by hand. Files named u-*, m-*, v-* and f-* were generated: each is a good fixture with one change (u: a field nobody defined added; m: a required field removed; v: a value replaced by one outside the list of allowed values; f: a fixed value replaced), and each proves the one rule its 'rule' names.

A plugin asks for its run to work in a worktree, not in the folder itself.

fixtures.rule: Today's reader refuses a top-level field it does not know, so version 1 adds none.
A grant is bound to one artifact digest.
A grant lists permissions the manifest schema defines.
A trusted key is 64 lower-case hex digits.
A signer is 'ed25519:' and 32 hex digits, or null for an unsigned plugin.
A grant holds ids, digests and permission names; a grant field the reader does not know is refused.
A reserved host is a non-empty string.
'run' is a permission of the version 1 manifest, and today's reader refuses a grant that lists it: an install file holds only what today's daemon reads.
The object described at install.v1.json#/$defs/grant always carries 'permissions'.
The object described at install.v1.json#/$defs/grant always carries 'plugin_id'.
The object described at install.v1.json#/properties/reserved is closed: a field nobody defined is refused.

A path has no '..', no '.' segment and does not start with a slash.
'network' is asked together with at least one destination.
A destination is listed only with the network permission.
A new permission is appended to the list in the schema; a manifest cannot invent one.
'host' is the core's name and no plugin may claim it.
The only runtime in this draft is 'python-inprocess/1'.
credential_refs holds names. A value with spaces or capitals is not a name.

The manifest is a closed set of fields: the signed bytes mean one thing.
